groups.role_statement: This paragraph presents feature-by-feature usage statistics, ratings, or theme-frequency counts drawn from the study's survey/interview data, offering concrete quantitative grounding for the qualitative feedback discussed alongside or after it.

groups.role_statement: These paragraphs disclose a scope-limiting caveat within the system design section, acknowledging a manual, exploratory, or author-constructed aspect of a core design parameter/mechanism and bounding the validity or generalizability claims that the design presentation is entitled to make, before the paper proceeds to its evaluation.

members.tag: This paragraph applies the structural grouping concept introduced just before it, illustrating with concrete examples how items are clustered under shared patterns and pointing the reader to further illustrative material, while also previewing the navigation mechanisms (sequential stepping and a broader overview mode) that will be elaborated in the subsequent paragraph, thereby bridging the conceptual definition of the grouping method to its practical interface controls.

This paragraph extends the preceding caveat by identifying a second assumption underlying a visualized component, clarifying the conditions on which its interpretive validity depends, and noting the specific scale at which the implementation was constructed for the purposes of the evaluation described later in the paper.

groups.role_statement: Each passage opens its results subsection by reporting the primary quantitative comparison across experimental conditions, establishing the headline finding that anchors and is elaborated upon by the subsequent, more detailed analyses.

groups.role_statement: These paragraphs open the results section by stating the analytical/presentational approach used to derive the findings and then provide a high-level summary overview of participants' overall positive reactions, serving to orient readers before the detailed thematic or feature-specific breakdowns that follow.

This paragraph provides an overview of aggregate quantitative outcomes, synthesizing standardized workload and satisfaction metrics with high-level counts of positive and negative participant feedback, setting up the more detailed qualitative breakdown that follows in subsequent paragraphs.

groups.role_statement: Each passage introduces a secondary, supporting interface feature—distinct from the core mechanism just described—that supplies supplementary contextual or disambiguating information (or rationale) on demand, addressing a gap or potential point of confusion left by the preceding core feature before the design discussion proceeds.

members.tag: This paragraph introduces another specific interface feature within the broader feature inventory, explaining its mechanism and purpose, and noting a supplementary capability for exporting the resulting user-generated content to support external sharing.

groups.role_statement: Each passage surveys a specific cluster of prior tools or techniques closely related to the paper's own approach, summarizing their capabilities and then exposing a shared limitation or unaddressed gap that the paper's contribution is positioned to fill, thereby justifying the work's novelty relative to that nearest body of related work.

members.tag: This paragraph surveys a range of prior tools that support reading within or anchored to a single document, situating them along a spectrum of task support, and uses this survey to clarify a conceptual boundary (document-centric vs. corpus-centric) that sets up the contrast the section will draw with the present approach.

This paragraph closes the subsection by drawing a contrast between the reviewed prior systems and the present work, identifying a shared shortcoming of the former (reliance on users' own working memory to organize materials) and positioning the proposed approach as addressing that gap, thereby transitioning the reader from background review toward the paper's own contribution.

It opens the section by defining the general problem the section addresses and outlining the common technical approach prior work has taken to solve it, setting up the scope and criteria against which subsequent related work will be compared.

This paragraph surveys closely related prior techniques to identify a specific gap they leave unaddressed, then positions the current work's approach as directly filling that gap, thereby sharpening the paper's claimed contribution relative to the most comparable existing solutions.

This paragraph opens the section's survey of prior tools by introducing the most accessible, non-technical category of existing solutions, characterizing their general approach and noting a shared shortcoming that sets up the need for the more specialized tools discussed in subsequent paragraphs.
